criteria.description: Document ABI purpose, handle lifecycle, threading, ownership, error model, result iteration, vector representation, and connector fixture contract.
criteria.evidence: docs/embedding-abi.md covers versioning, handles, lifecycle, ownership, SQL execution, result iteration, value model, diagnostics, threading/concurrency, and connector fixtures.
criteria.notes: FR coverage is also mapped in docs/acceptance-phase9-embedding-abi.md.

criteria.description: Add a C ABI module and header with opaque handles, row/value access, and status reporting.
criteria.evidence: include/shovelerdb.h declares opaque database/result/row handles, status and diagnostic enums, view structs, lifecycle, execution, result, value, and diagnostic symbols; src/abi/c_api.zig exports the matching ABI.
criteria.notes: The C header syntax check passed with cc -x c -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -fsyntax-only.

criteria.description: Support open-or-create and close for filesystem-backed embedded databases without requiring a daemon or global singleton.
criteria.evidence: shovelerdb_open_or_create, shovelerdb_checkpoint, and shovelerdb_close are implemented in src/abi/c_api.zig and src/abi/handles.zig; tests/integration/abi_acceptance.zig opens, checkpoints, closes, reopens, and verifies persisted rows.

criteria.description: Support SQL execution through the ABI for DDL, DML, transaction statements, and SELECT queries over the accepted dialect.
criteria.evidence: shovelerdb_execute routes through the embedded SQL path; tests/integration/abi_acceptance.zig executes CREATE TABLE, BEGIN, INSERT, COMMIT, vector-ranking SELECT, and persistence verification SELECT through the ABI.

criteria.description: Expose result metadata and row/value iteration for null, integer, float, boolean, text, blob, and float32 vector values.
criteria.evidence: include/shovelerdb.h declares result metadata, row iteration, value-kind, scalar, text/blob, and vector accessors; src/abi/result.zig and src/abi/value_access.zig implement the value layer; tests/integration/abi_acceptance.zig reads integer, text, float, and vector values and checks mismatched accessor type status.
criteria.notes: The value model is documented in docs/embedding-abi.md.

criteria.description: Make ABI-owned results and borrowed string/value views explicitly tied to releasable result/database lifetimes with no caller responsibility for Zig allocators.
criteria.evidence: shovelerdb_result_release handles result cleanup and null release; tests/integration/abi_acceptance.zig exercises result release and null release; docs/embedding-abi.md and docs/connector-fixtures.md document borrowed text, blob, vector, row, and diagnostic lifetimes.
criteria.notes: Connectors copy borrowed views only when host-runtime lifetime requires it.

criteria.description: Expose stable ABI diagnostic/status codes for parser, object, transaction, type, vector, persistence, invalid-handle, and allocation failures.
criteria.evidence: include/shovelerdb.h declares status and diagnostic enums; src/abi/diagnostics.zig centralizes status mapping and messages; tests/integration/abi_acceptance.zig validates vector-error diagnostics and invalid-handle checkpoint status.
criteria.notes: shovelerdb_status_diagnostic_code, shovelerdb_status_message, and shovelerdb_database_last_diagnostic are exported from src/abi/c_api.zig.

criteria.description: Add an ABI acceptance smoke covering open, table creation, transaction inserts, vector ranking, typed error, checkpoint/close/reopen, and persistence verification.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/abi_acceptance.zig covers the full connector lifecycle and build.zig wires it into zig build test.
criteria.notes: Validated by zig build test on the integrated mission branch and on main after WP05 merge.

criteria.description: Add connector fixture documentation that future language packages can reuse without duplicating behavior assumptions.
criteria.evidence: docs/connector-fixtures.md defines the shared connector fixture and points to tests/integration/abi_acceptance.zig, docs/embedding-abi.md, and include/shovelerdb.h.
criteria.notes: The fixture explicitly rejects daemon, network, auth, replication, plugin, and storage-engine requirements.

criteria.description: Keep existing SQL, transaction, persistence, view/procedure, vector, concurrency, adapted fixture, and benchmark tests passing.
criteria.evidence: zig build test passed after all Phase 9 WPs were integrated; the build includes library, CLI, integration, adapted fixture, vector, concurrency, and benchmark suites wired in build.zig.
criteria.notes: Additional checks passed: zig fmt --check, git diff --check, and C header syntax compile.

criteria.description: Refresh roadmap and README status so Phase 9 is active only for the ABI foundation, not every language connector package.
criteria.evidence: README.md and docs/project-plan.md describe Phase 9 as active for the embedding ABI foundation and call out full language connector packages as follow-up work.
criteria.notes: docs/acceptance-phase9-embedding-abi.md preserves the same scope boundary.
